briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore yesterday evening.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple reports from Star of Mysore and The Hindu confirm that crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore on several occasions. A crocodile was spotted in January 2026, December 2024, September 2023, and March 2010. These sightings indicate a recurring presence of crocodiles in the lake, sometimes causing panic among local residents and leading to interventions by the Forest Department.
gaps_en: No evidence specifically mentions two crocodiles being seen on 2026-10-07.
No official statements or direct reports confirm the specific event described in the post.
